pools.name: Employment, applications and job research
pools.rule: Broker/developer/agency roles; internships; walk-ins; CVs; interviews; salaries; application-only searches. Exclude full employment intent, not generic job, salary, vacancy or career words.

pools.name: Courses, examinations and academic work
pools.rule: Broker exam preparation, course fees, assignments, thesis-only searches. Preserve genuine buyer guides, floor plans, due diligence and school-location demand.

pools.name: Software, website and unrelated vendor procurement
pools.rule: Buying real-estate CRM software, website themes, source code and listing plugins. Protect technology companies seeking premises.

pools.name: Stock media, games and content-only downloads
pools.rule: Wallpaper packs, stock photos, game assets and entertainment-only searches. Protect property brochures and floor-plan requests.

pools.name: Contractor, repair and unrelated service requests
pools.rule: Plumbing, repairs, materials and contractor hiring where not a brokerage request. Protect investors buying renovation opportunities and occupiers seeking suitable premises.

pools.name: Non-property products and unrelated rentals
pools.rule: Vehicles, tools, costume rentals and other clearly different products. Do not exclude rental, rent, lease or commercial as global tokens.

pools.name: Unserved navigation, support and observed irrelevant queries
pools.rule: Login/password and support-only requests or other observed incompatible queries. Exact and narrow scopes; protect complaints leading to broker switching and genuine owner/tenant requests.
